BAYLINK 能帮你更快接到本地信息，但它不是魔法筛子。平台能提供手机验证、资: BAYLINK helps you find local information faster, but it cannot catch everything automatically. Phone verification, profile review, reporting, blocking, and administrator review are useful trust tools. They work best alongside your own judgment.
先把平台工具理解对：它们是降低风险，不是绝对担保: Understand the tools: They reduce risk, but are not a guarantee
手机号已验证：该账号完成过短信验证码验证，不代表真实身份或服务资质已经核实。: Phone verified: The account completed SMS code verification. This does not verify the person's actual identity or service qualifications.
资料审核：该账号提交的资料通过 BAYLINK 人工审核，不是政府认证，也不保证: Profile review: BAYLINK manually reviewed the account's submitted information. This is not government certification and does not guarantee continuing qualifications or transaction outcomes.
举报：让可疑行为进入平台处理流程。: Reporting: brings suspicious behavior into the platform's review process.
屏蔽：减少骚扰和无效沟通。: Blocking: reduces harassment and unproductive conversations.
管理员审核：帮助清理明显违规内容。: Administrator review: Helps remove clearly prohibited content.
有验证或审核标识，也照样要看房、验货、留合同和聊天记录。: A verification or review badge is no reason to skip viewing, inspecting, getting a contract or keeping the chat.
手机验证和资料审核，分别怎么用更实际: How to use phone verification and profile review in practice
找房、找室友、找服务时，可以优先看已完成手机验证的账号；如果是房东、商家、本地服: When looking for housing, roommates, or services, you can start with phone-verified accounts. For landlords, businesses, providers, or frequent posters, consider profile review too. Treat these as an initial screening layer, not a final conclusion.
举报按钮什么时候该用，不用太犹豫: When to use the report button—don't hesitate unnecessarily
对方身份和内容明显前后不一致。: The person's identity and content are clearly inconsistent.
一直催你脱离平台沟通并先付款。: They keep urging you to leave the platform and pay first.
房源、服务、二手信息疑似盗图或虚构。: Housing, service, or used-item posts appear fabricated or use stolen photos.
骚扰、辱骂、威胁或持续刷屏。: Harassment, insults, threats, or repeated spam.
同一个人换号重复发类似可疑内容。: The same person uses different accounts to repeatedly post similar suspicious content.
屏蔽不是小题大做，是给自己留边界: Blocking is a way to set boundaries
不是所有问题都严重到必须举报，但很多沟通确实不值得继续。一直压价、反复改时间、情: Not every problem calls for a report, but plenty of conversations aren't worth continuing. Repeated lowballing, rescheduling, personal attacks, late-night harassment, or an account that makes you uncomfortable can often be handled more easily by blocking than by arguing.
平台内留痕，比“聊得投机”更重要: Keeping records on the platform matters more than hitting it off
不管是找房、找室友、买二手还是请服务，能在平台内或至少保留完整聊天记录，通常都更: Whether you're finding housing, roommates, used items, or services, keep the conversation on the platform or at least preserve a complete record. If a problem arises, screenshots, pricing, schedules, and written promises are more useful than “they said it out loud.”
付款方式本身就是信号: The payment method is itself a signal
FTC 写明：有人坚持只能用电汇（Western Union、MoneyGram: The FTC says that if anyone insists you can only pay by wire transfer (Western Union, MoneyGram), gift cards or cryptocurrency, it’s a scam. Report it on BAYLINK, and you can also report it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.
如果你已经开始觉得“我是不是想太多了”，先别急着说服自己。大多数踩坑都不是因为用: If you're already wondering whether you're being too cautious, don't rush to talk yourself out of it. Problems often arise when people skip a check to save a step, not because they checked too carefully.
先把信任工具用起来，再开始联系: Use the trust tools before making contact
在 BayLink 上找房、找服务、做二手之前，先看账号信息是否完整、是否完成验: Before finding housing, hiring services, or trading secondhand items on BayLink, check whether the account information is complete and verification is done. If you've encountered suspicious content, use reporting and blocking to protect yourself.
